release_notes: Build 136 keeps Quiz Autopilot's project-media watcher off the WPF UI thread so background batch work no longer repeatedly blocks the app while it is running.
The media watcher now polls once per second instead of every 150 ms, reducing repeated SQLite history scans from roughly seven per second to one per second.
The quiz question bank is loaded once for the batch instead of reloading up to 10,000 questions on every polling pass.
Each newly created project is persisted once after quiz.json is ready, avoiding repeated image copies while preserving a final catch-up pass when batch rendering ends.
